excluded.reason: Source discovery and refresh are not compiled into the beta command catalog.
Catalog ingestion is not a beta capability.
Catalog inspection and query are not beta capabilities.
Context plan, compile, explain, diff, revalidate, and materialize are excluded.
Retrieval and ranking operations are outside the beta boundary.
Handoff create, inspect, accept, revoke, and merge are excluded.
Space fork, publish, log, conflict, and checkpoint workflows are excluded.
Replay reconstruction, execution, comparison, and completeness are excluded.
Policy evaluation and explanation are not beta capabilities.
The beta ships no cigard executable or daemon lifecycle surface.
External effect execution is outside the embedded-local beta boundary.
Extension loading and extension distribution are not beta surfaces.
The beta publishes archives only; it has no system installer.
Qualification is restricted to Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 with glibc 2.39.
The MCP server and protocol surface are excluded from the beta.
No image, image index, or container deployment is a beta artifact.
OTLP export and collector integration are outside the beta boundary.
No plugin package or plugin runtime is distributed in the beta.
Remote execution and remote service access are excluded.
Rust, TypeScript, Python, and Go SDK packages are excluded.
Shared-service and multi-user deployment modes are excluded.
Vector backends, vector indexing, and vector export are excluded.
Qualification is restricted to Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 with glibc 2.39.
ARM and AArch64 builds are not initial-beta artifacts.
Backup and restore administration are not compiled into the beta.
GC planning and execution are not beta capabilities.
Diagnostic bundle and doctor operations are excluded.
HTTP, gRPC, socket, and other service listeners are excluded.
Completion and manual-page generator commands are excluded.

included.description: Local init plus source, project, and focus metadata administration against private workspace state.
